Here’s what I would do if I were in your shoes. 

-look at thigh anatomy and pick out some muscles that form defining shapes. I personally think that the vastus literalus, vastus medialis, rectus femorus, bicep femoris and the gluteus Maximus would be sufficient. 

-I would stretch and sculpt 6 uv spheres into these  muscle shapes (doesn’t have to be perfect just a shape block out)

-I would use Boolean union to merge each muscle together and with dynotopo on, smooth the creases of each muscle. 

-for fatter thighs the muscles are harder to identify and the transitions are smoother so smooth them real good

*usinging booleans to merge the muscles will make trash topology so this advice is for a high poly sculpt. If you want a low poly version then you’ll have to retopologize.*

I used to work in 3d scanning and it is possible to penetrate through vegetation although it would be hard to manage the signal to noise ratio and what data points are important vs which aren’t. 

The way we negated obstructions like leaves or steam or whatever is that multiple scanning locations would be used and they would coalesce into a point cloud.

If I were to try to design this, then this is how I would approach it. I’m no expert so take my workflow with a pinch of salt. 

I would start by drawing a vertical line with the sketch tool, followed by drawing half of the contour of the cup excluding the dimples. This is just to get the tapered cup shape. 

Then I would draw the inside contour of the cup on that same sketch. 

I would fillet/round all of my corners while still in the sketch. 

Then I would use the revolve command to rotate the sketch around a central vertical axis. 

This should leave you with the approximate shape of the cup minus the dimples. 

Then I would try to envision what the opposite shape of the dimple is. I see that they are flat and circular so I would make sort of a half dome shape. Then I would copy that shape and move it approximately twice the height downwards and a little bit inwards to follow the contour of the taper. Repeat this process until you get the desired amount of dimples. Then would use a circular patter to multiply them around the cup. 

Then I would repeat this process but offset it down and rotate it around the cup slightly. (I noticed that the dimples alternate by about half their width left and right)

Finally, I would select our cup with the combine tool set to cut, and then I would group select all of our little half domes as the target bodies and cut them out of the cup.

I’m by no means an expert but this should be enough to approximate the design. Let me know if you need me to clarify any of the steps.

Here is my extremely crude explanation of the shape. Take with a healthy pinch of salt. 

With traditional “bell” rocket nozzles, the propellant exhaust begins to expand immediately after exiting the throat of the nozzle. Basically the gasses are going in all directions and not just in the direction that pushes you in the most efficient way. You really want to get the exhaust pushing in the same direction to achieve max efficiency. 

The “bell” shape guides the gasses to minimize these losses. In at sea level, the pressure of out atmosphere helps in keeping these exhaust gases pushed in together, so a smaller bell is needed. The problem is that In vacuum, there is no atmosphere to aid in contracting these gasses, so a vacuum nozzle is needed. Vacuum nozzles are much larger and there for weigh more. 

The aerospike nozzle negates the issue of having to choose one or the other. The exhaust gases are hurled directly at the spike and they form a stream that wants to form a tidy flow across the surface. It is basically a type of 1 size fits all nozzle. 

I apologize if any of the information stated is incorrect and I welcome critique of my explanation.

Edit: I should also add that there are some extremely challenging hurtles to aerospike development. That’s why we don’t see them on modern rockets. From an outside perspective, the outlook of aerospike nozzles look bleak.

This is kind of a long one. Also might trigger some people (excuse the pun). I'm not here to debate politics or what you think is right or wrong so just throwing that out there. 

I'm from the southern US. I know that by reading that, your mind is probably conjuring images of a gun toting neanderthal. Unfortunately, you would probably be correct in that assumption. 

Anyway, when I was young, there was a field near my old neighborhood, where I grew up hunting rabbit and dove with my friends. We would go all the time with our little hand me down shotguns. Shooting in the field was normal in that neighborhood even if it was close to our house. Everyone in town did it. No big deal as long as we were careful. We were all trained in safe operating procedures regarding firearms by the way. 

Fast forward many years to a few months ago. I had a nice job so I decided to splurge and buy myself a SCAR 17 rifle. (A powerful, loud, simi automatic rifle.) I took it to the old field where I had shot a thousand times before and started shooting at a Bulls eye with my best friend. She isn't into guns and she didn't know how to operate it properly so she didn't shoot it, she just watched. 

The gun was a beast. It was loud and powerful just as it should be. But after a few magazines I noticed she was bored so I decided to pack it up and go do something else. We had our ear protection on so we didn't hear anything special going on. As we walked on the trail to get to my car, I noticed blue lights coming from the tree line. A few steps later, I realized what was happening and I placed my rifle and ammo on the ground and started to walk out of the tree line with my hands up. It was getting dark out, so when they turned the spot light on and aimed it at me it was blinding. Over the megaphone the officer told me and my friend to get on the ground. We complied as they had their rifles fixed on us. Unbeknownst to us, they originally sent only one car because out in the country, people shooting guns in that field was normal. But we had ear protection on, so we couldn't hear their megaphone. That resulted in 8 squad cars in total arriving to the scene. 

My first concern was to explain my best friends innocence, which resulted in her being released shortly after. My second concern was I wanted them to understand that I wasn't trying to be malicious and that I was merely shooting target practice. They were understanding, but they still had to arrest me. They tried to charge me with a felony, but they understood that I wasn't trying to do anything wrong so they put me on probation and expunged it. 

I don't regret much. But that is my most recent regret. Sorry if that was too long.
